title: SecureStack: failed send leaves stale pending_requests entry causing CorrelationMismatch on identical retry
description: Discovered during milq/mybk gateway handoff tests. SecureStack::send_secure_response_to (rust/lichen-node/src/secure.rs:1427-1431) correlates the outgoing response to pending_requests by inner request equality (code+options+payload+sender); the entry is removed only on successful send (secure.rs:1511). After a failed send (e.g. GatewayOscoreSenderStore persistence failure), the stale entry remains, so a retry whose inner payload is byte-identical builds its response from the stale entry's token/MID/request-PIV and the client sees CorrelationMismatch. Retry tests in end_to_end.rs work around it by rebuilding the handoff payload with a fresh timestamp (realistic but masks the bug). Fix: drop the pending entry on send failure, or match by request PIV.
